name: Long March 2D
location_str: LC-9 @ Taiyuan Satellite Launch Center, CHN
slot_a_text: 3 launches from LC-9 so far this year. 79 in total since it opened.
slot_b_text: The 45th launch of the year for China's CASC, 615th all time. 3rd from LC-9 this year, 33 days since the last one. The 226th orbital launch attempt worldwide this year. Long March 2D is on a 68-flight success streak.
rocket_fact: The 'pogo oscillation' is a dangerous vibration caused by fuel surging in the pipes, which can shake a rocket to pieces.
